title: Read the task, check the threshold (4 Nov 2026)
summary: A laptop benchmark shows when a fine-tuned 150M encoder beats a prompted 4B model and when it only ties, XDecideBench finds English-fitted confidence thresholds and model picks don't hold across 122 languages, BERT students distilled from an LLM beat their teacher on sentences that carry sentiment, a study of selective escalation shows that finding errors is not the same as fixing them, and a 560M Tajik embedder fine-tuned in under an hour.
